json.name: Daily-to-Monthly Active User Ratio
json.elaborated_description: The Daily-to-Monthly Active User Ratio (DAU/MAU) is a key performance indicator that measures user engagement within a business intelligence platform. This metric quantifies the proportion of users who engage with the platform on a daily basis compared to those who engage at least once in a month. A higher DAU/MAU ratio indicates that users are not only accessing the platform regularly but are also finding value in its features and insights. This stickiness metric is crucial for understanding user retention and the effectiveness of content governance strategies. By analyzing this ratio, organizations can identify trends in user behavior and make informed decisions to enhance user experience and drive deeper engagement with BI tools.

json.name: Refresh Timeliness

It specifically measures the frequency and punctuality of updates to dashboards, ensuring that users have access to the most current data for decision-making. The scope of this metric encompasses all dashboards within the BI environment, focusing on their ability to deliver timely insights. Ultimately, it serves as a critical indicator of the overall health of the BI system and its capacity to support informed business decisions.

A high coverage score indicates that a significant proportion of assets are well-managed, with clear ownership and defined quality standards, facilitating trust and reliability in decision-making processes. By monitoring governance coverage, organizations can enhance their data stewardship practices and ensure that decision-makers have access to high-quality, well-governed data.
